function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_add_custom_dashboard
function.description: This function adds a new custom dashboard to the system. It allows users to create a personalized view with widgets and data relevant to their needs. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

dashboard_name.description: The name of the new custom dashboard.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user for whom the dashboard is being created.

widgets.description: A list of widget identifiers to be included in the custom dashboard.

layout.description: The layout format of the dashboard.

theme.description: The visual theme of the dashboard.

refresh_rate.description: The rate at which the dashboard data refreshes, in seconds.

function.name: get_custom_dashboard
function.description: Retrieves a custom dashboard by its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

customDashboardId.description: The unique identifier of the custom dashboard to be retrieved.

function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_delete_custom_dashboard
function.description: Deletes a specific custom dashboard identified by its unique ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

customDashboardId.description: The unique identifier of the custom dashboard to be deleted.

message.content:
I’m happy to help!  
Could you let me know exactly what you’d like to do?

| Option | What happens |
|--------|--------------|
| **Retrieve** a dashboard | I’ll look up the dashboard *by its unique ID* using `get_custom_dashboard`. Please share the ID if you already have it. |
| **Create** a new “dashing” dashboard | I can set it up for you with your preferred widgets, layout, theme, etc., using `CustomDashboardsApi_add_custom_dashboard`. Just tell me the details you’d like. |

If you’re unsure how to proceed, feel free to give me as much context as possible—e.g., who owns the dashboard, what kind of widgets you want, or where you found the reference to “dashing.” That way I can guide you through the next steps.
